title: St. Vincent–St. Mary vs. GlenOak — Baseball (2025–2026)
summary: St. Vincent–St. Mary Fighting Irish vs. GlenOak Golden Eagles — 2025–2026 high school baseball season coverage. Photography by Mason Bybee.
article_headline: St. Vincent–St. Mary vs. GlenOak: From the Diamond
article_dek: The Fighting Irish and Golden Eagles in an archival baseball photo essay.
article_body:
Baseball is a game of anticipation and split-second movement: the release of a pitch, a runner leaving the bag and a defender reacting to contact. Those moments are central to this matchup between St. Vincent–St. Mary and GlenOak.

This archive documents the players and on-field action through Mason Bybee’s photography. It does not attach an unverified box score to the images.
